$comment: Runtime qualification record for the Bun 1.4 migration on preview-dev.
candidate.revision is the build qualification runs against, fetched from the
oven-sh/bun GitHub 'canary' release (npm has no 1.4 line yet).
qualifiedRevisions is the ONLY list src/ may trust. A revision enters it after
CI has executed the suite against that exact revision on every supported OS —
downloading a binary is not qualification. src/lib/bun-stream-caps.ts and the
worker settle gate read this list; writing a revision here on faith defeats the
entire point of gating on revision instead of on a version string.
